name: Studio
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity raster desktop application design prototype for Imagine.
Create one polished landscape design board, about 2400x1500, straight-on crisp screen design, no perspective or devices. It must show TWO distinct views of ONE concept: large complete Image workspace at LEFT occupying about 68% of board and a separate complete floating Settings WINDOW at RIGHT occupying about 30%. The right region is an enlarged companion view of the settings dialog, not a permanent inspector. Make BOTH views legible, not overlapping. Small concept number/name caption outside app only; no explanatory paragraphs.
Brand: "Imagine". Native compact professional creative tool, realistic shippable UI, system sans typography with monospace prompt field. This is an evolution of current native Rust image-generation UI. Existing features ONLY: Prompt, collapsible Negative prompt; 0-10 ordered reference images with add, move up/down, remove; aspect Ratio, Max side and resolved dimensions; Random/fixed Seed; Steps and CFG; generate/retry/cancel; sampling progress and ETA; result preview fit/actual pixels and pan; output folder; privacy hover reveal; connected/reconnect status.
Navigation: exactly TWO visually distinct ICON-ONLY tabs, landscape/image glyph selected and film/video glyph inactive. Active tab peach/gold. No video editor content. Header title "Imagine", secondary "Qwen Image 2.1", green connected dot, gear icon, eye privacy icon. Tabs, every action button and close button are icon-only: NO text on buttons, including generate (sparkle/play glyph), add (+), retry (circular arrow), cancel (square), folder (folder glyph), reordering (arrows), remove (trash), close (x). Labels beside form fields ARE text. Selected tab may have small hover tooltip "Image"; video glyph should remain obvious. No labeled action buttons.
Settings window: title "Settings", top-right x icon; concise section headings "Generation", "Storage", "Privacy"; editable fields "Steps" = "40", "CFG" = "2.5"; "Save to" = "~/Pictures/Imagine" with folder icon button; "Hide previews" switch OFF for this illustrated sample. Footer small noninteractive "Saved" status. Settings autosave; no Save/Cancel button. Settings uses compact 10px corners and diagonal dark gradient. No network credentials, no invented models, no sampler controls, no theme picker, no account controls.
Workspace fields: "Prompt" containing only "A quiet mountain lake at dawn"; collapsed "Negative prompt"; "References · 2/10"; "Ratio" = "16:9"; "Max side" = "1600"; resolved "1600 × 896 px"; "Seed" = "Random". Reference thumbnails are newly invented mountain/forest scenes, with numbers 1 and 2 and reorder/remove icons. Main preview is a NEW fictional photorealistic alpine lake at dawn with soft gold light, reflects mountains; landscape 16:9 contained without distortion. This is synthetic design content. Privacy is OFF visibly (eye icon neutral, settings toggle off), consistent with visible media. Do not imply privacy on while revealing all images. Completed state "Saved" with compact "Seed 284731" metadata; no gallery, history, timeline, layers, drawing tools, chat, or extra product features.
Exact Helto palette: background #181825; panels #1e1e2e; input fields #313244; elevated control gradient #45475a to #313244; subtle borders #313244 and strong #45475a; media well #11111b. Main text #cdd6f4; secondary #a6adc8; faint #7f849c. Active/selected/primary accent #fab387 with pale #fddcc4 icon/text, dark warm gradient #4f3a2a to #3d2d20 and border #93664a. Never bright solid orange buttons. Blue #89b4fa for keyboard focus ONLY. Success #a6e3a1; destructive #f38ba8. Compact 5px control radius, 6px panels; 28px square icon buttons, 26px form fields, 34px toolbars at logical scale. Fine 1.8px outline icons. Tiny subtle shadows, sharp spacing, no neon, no black/white redesign, no huge pill buttons, no decorative gradients except prescribed controls/modal.
Keep all exact UI labels spelled correctly and legible. Do not add helper copy, marketing, subtitles or onboarding. Show a finished app interface rather than a wireframe.

Concept: 01 / Studio
Layout direction: A classic compact 320px LEFT composer inspector: Prompt tall at top, collapsed Negative prompt, two numbered reference thumbnails with up/down/trash controls, Ratio and Max side inline, Seed row; primary sparkle icon at bottom. Dominant image viewport RIGHT with small fit/actual-pixel icon toolbar underneath. Two icon tabs in header left of center. Orderly and balanced.
